description: Source code for managing draft messages in the Mattermost server, including functions to get, upsert, delete drafts, and handle associated file info.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing methods to manage drafts.

methods.name: GetDraft
methods.description: Retrieves a draft for a user in a specific channel and root message ID.

methods.name: UpsertDraft
methods.description: Creates or updates a draft message, including handling file info and WebSocket notifications.

methods.name: GetDraftsForUser
methods.description: Fetches all drafts for a specific user within a team.

methods.name: DeleteDraft
methods.description: Deletes a specified draft and notifies via WebSocket.
